patches.repl:
<script>
  // PERF2: the first layout that holds the toolbar / Tools-sheet glyphs (emoji and symbol fallback fonts) costs 30-40 ms. It is paid here, at idle time after the page has
  // settled (3.2 s after load, after the window in which the load metrics are taken), instead of inside the first tap of Tools / Unit Roster / Legend.  A detached canvas
  // measures the same text with the same fonts: the page's DOM is not touched.
  (function () {
    function warm() {
      try {
        var c = document.createElement('canvas').getContext('2d');
        if (!c) return;
        c.font = '22px "Times New Roman"'; c.measureText('\uD83D\uDD0D F \u2694 \u2630 \uD83D\uDDFF \uD83D\uDD2D \u2B50 \uD83D\uDCCF \uD83D\uDDFA \uD83D\uDCCD ? \u2715 \u22EF');
        c.font = '12px sans-serif'; c.measureText('Search Filter Order of Battle Unit Roster Monuments');
        c.font = 'bold 16px Georgia, serif'; c.measureText('Tools');
      } catch (e) {}
    }
    function later() { setTimeout(function () { if (window.requestIdleCallback) window.requestIdleCallback(warm, { timeout: 2000 }); else setTimeout(warm, 300); }, 3200); }
    if (document.readyState === 'complete') later(); else window.addEventListener('load', later);
  })();
</script>
</body>
patches.note: phone: the first tap of Tools took 40-60 ms in the click (a 51 ms long task in acceptance check 4; second tap: 4 ms): the layout of the sheet is the first one that needs the emoji / symbol fallback fonts. Measured on 6 first taps each: handler time median 40 ms -> 27 ms; the warm-up itself is one 13 ms task at idle and touches no DOM (an earlier variant that inserted a hidden element produced a late DOM mutation that the response detection of the acceptance harness mistook for the answer to a tap)
